36: function formatPromptValue(value: unknown): string {
37:   if (value === null) {
38:     return 'null';
39:   }
40:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
41:     return `[${value.map(formatPromptValue).join(',')}]`;
42:   }
43:   if (typeof value === 'object') {
44:     const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
45:     return `{${Object.keys(record)
46:       .sort()
47:       .map((key) => `${key}:${formatPromptValue(record[key])}`)
48:       .join(',')}}`;
49:   }
50:   if (typeof value === 'string') {
51:     return `"${value.replaceAll('\\', '\\\\').replaceAll('"', '\\"')}"`;
52:   }
53:   if (typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean' || typeof value === 'bigint') {
54:     return String(value);
55:   }
56:   if (typeof value === 'undefined') {
57:     return 'undefined';
58:   }
59:   return Object.prototype.toString.call(value);
60: }

253:       if (abiResult.status !== 'ok') {

344:     // 4. Ask the LLM to verbalize only; code-native actions enter via predecidedActions.

347:       await this.planLimits.ensureTokenBudget(params.workspaceId);

397:           await this.actions.logAutopilotEvent(workspaceId, contactId, toolName, {}, blockedResult);
398:           return;
399:         }

409:           phone,
410:           toolName,

413:         );
414:         actionsList.push({ tool: toolName, args: toolArgs, result });

453:       intent,
454:       confidence,
